implementationBoundary: RaceMenu NG GPL-3.0 code is the implementation base.
CommonLibSSE-NG, Skyrim VR Address Library, and SKSEVR provide permitted contracts and address evidence.
SKEEVR source code and binaries are not copied; externally identified hook locations require independent executable qualification and a new local implementation.

groups.name: core-services
groups.consequence: SKSE lifecycle, serialization, Papyrus, and plugin interfaces remain available without a raw hook.

groups.name: vr-pointer-input
groups.consequence: RaceSexMenu loads its VR-coordinate movie before registration, owns one balanced cursor endpoint, claims VR Trigger/Accept in its own input handler, and dispatches native-coordinate Scaleform mouse edges.

groups.name: body-systems
groups.consequence: The qualified VR armor attachment callback feeds body morph, skeleton, and override observers; rendering overlays remain separately gated.

groups.name: native-face-sliders
groups.consequence: Qualified custom slider discovery, insertion, lookup, category invocation, and callbacks are available.

groups.name: face-morph-application
groups.consequence: Qualified extended TRI and per-head morph callbacks are available.

groups.name: sculpt-rendering
groups.consequence: The qualified RaceSexMenu render slot displays the separate sculpt world.

groups.name: head-preset-compatibility
groups.consequence: Qualified head preprocessing and mapped-preset regeneration are available.

groups.name: tint-and-inventory
groups.consequence: Qualified tint synchronization, inventory dyeing, and UID transfer are available.

groups.name: face-overlays
groups.consequence: Every qualified BSDynamicTriShape allocation, reassignment, resize, ordinary destruction, and virtual deleting-destruction path uses RaceMenu's refcount-aware buffer lifecycle; qualified head-state refresh hooks are also available.

groups.name: facegen-cache-bypass
groups.consequence: The exact FaceGen cache entry can be bypassed when explicitly configured.

directVrHelperQualification.policy: Before any SKEE hook group writes game memory, every locally used direct helper must be inside SkyrimVR.exe .text and match its independently captured SkyrimVR 1.4.15 entry window. One mismatch aborts the entire SKEE hook set.
